name: s3-compatible
description: Publishes the site's static export to S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, Wasabi, MinIO, ...) with the workspace's own saved access key. Ships the host code itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how an agent needs: what to set up in the bucket first, which credential fields go where, and what each failure means in plain words.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Puts your website online in your own storage bucket, like Amazon S3 or Cloudflare R2. The assistant shows you a preview first.

credentialCards.title: Connect S3-compatible storage
credentialCards.label: S3-compatible storage connection
credentialCards.intro: Connect your storage provider to upload this site to an existing public bucket. Create the bucket and public hosting first.
credentialCards.keyHint: Use an access key ID and secret access key limited to the selected bucket: ListBucket and GetObject, PutObject, DeleteObject on its objects. If using a separate private media bucket, grant only the required read/write access there too.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.label: Endpoint
fields.hint: Your storage service's API address — not your bucket's website address. Cloudflare R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Backblaze B2: check your bucket's 'Endpoint' field in the B2 dashboard. DigitalOcean Spaces: https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com. Wasabi: https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com. Plain AWS S3: leave this blank.

fields.name: region
fields.label: Region
fields.hint: The region your bucket lives in — e.g. us-east-1 for AWS, auto for Cloudflare R2, or your Space's region for DigitalOcean (e.g. nyc3). Needed to sign requests correctly even if your provider doesn't otherwise think in regions.

fields.name: bucket
fields.label: Bucket
fields.hint: The exact name of the bucket (DigitalOcean calls it a 'Space') to publish into. Case-sensitive. Tovu does not create this for you — create it in your provider's dashboard first.

fields.name: accessKeyId
fields.label: Access key ID
fields.hint: Created alongside your Secret Access Key when you make an API key pair. AWS: IAM → Security credentials → Access keys. Cloudflare R2: R2 → Manage API tokens. Backblaze B2: Application Keys. Use a key scoped to just this one bucket if your provider supports it — not an account-wide key.

fields.name: publicUrl
fields.label: Public URL
fields.hint: The address visitors open: your bucket's public URL, or a custom domain pointed at the bucket. Tovu checks it after every publish and tells you if it can't be reached.

fields.name: mediaBucket
fields.label: Media bucket (optional)
fields.hint: Optional. A separate private bucket for your uploads. Leave blank to keep uploads on the server.

fields.name: mediaKeyPrefix
fields.label: Media key prefix (optional)
fields.hint: Optional folder-like prefix for media objects in the media bucket, e.g. tovu-media/. Blank stores them at ws/… directly.
